gloss: text of a law; article; provision

definitions.gloss: text of a law; article; provision
definitions.explanation: The written text of individual articles or clauses in laws, regulations, treaties, or contracts.

examples.japanese: {条文|じょうぶん}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the text of the provision.

examples.japanese: この{条文|じょうぶん}の{解釈|かいしゃく}には{議論|ぎろん}がある。
examples.english: There is debate over the interpretation of this provision.

examples.japanese: {憲法|けんぽう}の{条文|じょうぶん}を{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ{読|よ}み{直|なお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to reread each article of the constitution one by one.

notes:
{条文|じょうぶん} refers to the actual written text of individual articles or clauses in legal documents. A formal term used in legal, political, and academic contexts.

COMPOUND: {条|じょう} (article/clause) + {文|ぶん} (text/writing)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {条文|じょうぶん}の{解釈|かいしゃく}: interpretation of the provision
- {条文|じょうぶん}を{改正|かいせい}する: to amend the text
- {条文|じょうぶん}に{基|もと}づく: based on the provision
- {憲法|けんぽう}の{条文|じょうぶん}: the text of the constitution
- {条文|じょうぶん}を{読|よ}む: to read the provisions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {条項|じょうこう}: article, clause (refers to the clause itself as a unit)
- {法令|ほうれい}: laws and ordinances (broader term)
- {規定|きてい}: regulation, stipulation (the rule itself, not its text)
